title: Dark northern sea
subject: Subject: the surface of a cold dark sea at night seen from above, about 4 m across. Deep navy and blue-black water with small, even ripples and scattered tiny pale glints of moonlight. No ice, no foam, no reflections of lamps.
use: The water all round the shipyard's rock.

title: Snowy slate roof
subject: Subject: a slate roof in winter, seen straight on, about 2 m across. Rows of small, rounded dark blue-grey slates, each with a little cap of snow on its lower edge, so the roof reads as even stripes of slate and snow. Moonlit night colours.
use: The roofs of the shipyard's buildings, and other snowy slate roofs in the north.

title: The shipyard gatehouse
subject: Subject: the shipyard's gatehouse, seen flat from the front. Two round towers of grey stone blocks with conical slate roofs under snow and one small lit window each, a crenellated wall between them with a round-arched gateway, two iron lanterns glowing beside the gate, and a navy banner with a gold sun and gold trim hanging on each tower. The whole gatehouse is in the picture.
use: The shipyard's gate at the head of the long bridge.

title: Shipyard sun banner
subject: Subject: a hanging cloth banner, seen flat from the front, about 1 m wide and 2 m long: deep navy cloth with a gold sun of straight and wavy rays in the middle, a thin gold border, and a swallow-tailed lower edge, hung from a short dark pole. Soft folds only.
use: On the shipyard's gatehouse towers and north wall.

title: Tall timber-framed house
subject: Subject: a tall three-storey house, seen flat from the front: a ground floor of grey stone with a wooden door and lit windows, two upper floors of dark timber framing with crossed braces and pale panels, rows of small-paned windows glowing warm, and a steep slate roof with snow on it. The whole house is in the picture.
use: The big house on the shipyard's west side.

title: The bunkhouse
subject: Subject: the shipyard's bunkhouse, seen flat from the front: a long, low timber-framed building on a stone footing, with arched wooden doors, small-paned windows glowing warm, a little dormer window in the snowy slate roof, and a lantern by the door. The whole building is in the picture.
use: Old Gil's bunkhouse, the shipyard's inn and rest spot.

title: The forge
subject: Subject: the shipyard forge, seen flat from the front: two open bays under a snowy slate roof held on dark timber posts and a timber-framed gable, a stone hearth in each bay with an orange fire, an anvil and hanging tools. The fire glows inside; no light spills out. The whole forge is in the picture.
use: The forge on the shipyard's east side.

title: Pim's hall
subject: Subject: a long one-storey hall, seen flat from the front: dark timber posts with green-painted panels and double doors, small warm-lit windows, two little lanterns, and a slate roof under snow with two gabled dormer windows. The whole building is in the picture.
use: Pim's shop on the shipyard's east side.

title: Ice floe
subject: Subject: one flat floe of sea ice, seen from straight above, about 4 m across: a slab with an irregular, blocky outline and a thin dark edge where it sits in the water, its top covered in pale blue-white snow with a few soft cracks. Night colours.
use: Floating in the sea round the shipyard, scaled and turned for variety.
